readme: Machine-readable form of fixtures/scenarios.md. Each scenario deep-merges `overrides` onto fixtures/subjects/subject-a.json (arrays and null replace wholesale), then the engine runs decide(state, date). `expected` asserts only the fields it names; `notes` is the user-approved prose expectation (2026-07-28 review). Conventions pinned by that review: HRV flag = strictly below baseline-0.75SD for >=3 consecutive days; deep-flag deload (>1SD, >=7d, corroborated by RHR+soreness, no illness) converts the week's intervals to Z2; tissue-caution defers a high-velocity/connective channel's plyo/sprint work on any reported pain when the site has recurrence history or elevated recent load, until 48h pain-free; SDC governs retests (sub-SDC threshold pass = indeterminate; future registrations must be >= baseline + SDC); a refused retest still updates the fitness estimate.

scenarios.notes: Do the planned interval session (4x4min Z5 run) exactly as standing. No gates, no surfaces, floors met by the standing plan.
Identical to N1. The single low morning reading (3.60) never enters the engine (I5); 7d mean 4.26 is above the 4.13 flag line.
CMJ delta -1.2cm < SDC 4.7cm: rendered 'no change detected' (I3), stripped by L6. Plan untouched.
Above-neck symptoms only: the L1 block is defined on systemic symptoms and does not fire. Standing plan; illness flag monitored.
Systemic illness is a hard block: no training today, sessions null. Section 6 ramp governs the coming days.
Day 1 post-resolution: easy aerobic only (Z2 ~30-40min sRPE<=3), mobility fine. No strength, no intensity. Plyo additionally blocked by the active HRV flag. 2-3 easy days before strength returns.

Next ramp stage: reintroduce strength at ~half volume, near-prior intensity; continue easy aerobic. No intervals this week (no interval work in week 1 back); no plyo yet (high-velocity last). Ramp scaled up for a 10-day illness.

L5 restructure under declared constraints (facts, not noisy signals; SDC gate does not apply). Strength floor via dumbbell work, interval session on the treadmill (run is VO2-capable, I9), remaining windows to short Z2. Floors protected.
Sleep duration (<7h: load increases blocked) and timing variance (>60min) surfaced. Standing plan proceeds unchanged - it is not an increase (I6). No HRV flag (4.16 > 4.13), no plyo block.

Forward-plan for the travel week: preserve Z2 volume (least robust) and 1 interval run (block continues, run capable); mobility daily; strength paused for the week (retained for weeks at zero dose). This week unchanged.
Sleep surfaced as the highest-value available action; load increases blocked. The standing interval session itself proceeds (not an increase). No plyo block (prior night not <6h, no HRV flag).
Plyo/max-velocity blocked (<6h prior night): today's jump primer replaced by a non-ballistic warmup; strength session otherwise proceeds. Sleep lever also surfaced; no load increases.
Timing-variance surface only. Standing plan unchanged.

Flag active (strictly below 4.13, sustained 5 days). Plyo/max-velocity blocked while flagged. The interval session proceeds as planned - the flag's enumerated effect is the plyo block, and the standing plan is the default. Deep-flag deload criteria not met (depth only ~0.9 SD, <7 days).
No flag (approved convention: strictly below baseline-0.75SD for >=3 consecutive days; at exactly the line for 2 days neither is met). Standing plan.

Approved deep-flag deload: >1SD suppression sustained 8 days, corroborated by elevated RHR and soreness, no illness. Plyo blocked; this week's intervals become Z2; strength held at maintenance. ACWR-style soft caution surfaced (may warn, never hard-block).

Competitive match yesterday suppresses today's lower-body load and planned plyo (s6): session becomes upper-emphasis strength, no jump primer; hamstring high-velocity exposure blocked for the tissue window. Recurrent-strain history cited in rationale.

Hike classified as Z2 aerobic + knee-extensor eccentric load (s6: not a rest day; sRPE 5 does not trigger following-day suppression). Today's strength proceeds with reduced knee-dominant volume (tissue recency, L5); the hike's aerobic load counts toward the week's Z2 volume.

The following-day suppression window has passed; the standing interval session proceeds with an ACWR-style soft caution surfaced (acute vo2max load well above chronic). Caution may warn, never hard-block (s6).

Approved tissue-caution convention: pain on a high-velocity channel with recurrence history defers that channel's sprint/plyo exposure until 48h pain-free. No strides today; session otherwise unchanged. The 3/10 pain block does not fire (2/10, no gait change).

Pain >3/10: knee-extensor pattern blocked with substitution (hinge-pattern lower work + upper accessory in place of squat volume); rest unchanged. Re-test the pattern when pain <=3/10 and movement quality is normal.

3/10 is not above 3/10, so the pain block does not fire; approved tissue-caution applies (pain at the line on a connective channel with elevated recent load): pogo removed, upper-body power substituted, rest proceeds.
SBP 7-day mean >=130: highest-priority non-emergent surface; the action is clinical follow-up. Training plan continues unchanged (I6).
Flag 3 weeks unaddressed: escalated salience - the surface persists atop every output until addressed. Still zero training-time impact; escalation is in prominence, never reallocation.
No flag (128 < 130); staleness surface: re-run the 7-day protocol (quarterly cadence missed by ~6 months; highest value-of-information measure, s8). Plan unchanged.

Threshold 55.5 not met (I10) and delta +1.5 < SDC 5.8, so reported strictly as 'no change detected' (I3) - never as 'you gained 1.5'. Block concludes: no detectable response at this dose. Trainability still not-yet-identifiable (1 block). Plan reverts to balanced maintenance; no auto-escalation of volume (s9).
Same verdict shape as RB1 (delta +1.3 < SDC 4.7; threshold 44.0 not met). Power remains in the floor tier regardless of test results (s4): the 10-15 min/wk exposure continues unchanged.

I10: evaluation refused - no success/failure verdict, no block conclusion. Approved: the measurement itself still updates fitness.vo2max (valid GXT result with its typicalError); it just cannot be read as a block outcome. Prompt to pre-register before any future retest.

Delta +6.1 > SDC 5.8 and threshold 55.5 met: change detected (I3) and block success (I10). fitness.vo2max updated to 58.6. Trainability posterior shifts up but remains not-yet-identifiable after one block (s7). L4 may shift budget toward vo2max, capped at 15% per step.

Approved: SDC governs. 55.8 clears the pre-registered 55.5 but delta +3.3 < SDC 5.8 - a threshold pass inside the noise band is noise, so the block outcome is indeterminate. The threshold was ill-posed at registration (inside 52.5 +/- 5.8); the engine henceforth refuses to register thresholds < baseline + SDC.
Delta -25 s/km clears SDC 22.2 and the <=305 threshold: success. fitness.lt1Pace updated; run zone boundaries re-derived from the new measured threshold (I9 - never from formulas).

Floors consume the entire 180min; L4 allocates nothing. 2 compressed strength sessions (~40min, >=4 hard sets per major pattern), 1 interval run (~40min - the block session, preserved), ~60min Z2 (least robust to reduction), power inside strength, mobility as habit.

Floors-only shape both weeks. The block's accumulation dose is cut in its final stretch - recorded in block context - but the week-8 retest proceeds against the original pre-registered threshold (I10: immutable; no re-registration because the block got harder).

Sleep lever surfaced as the top action of the entire output (adding training hours while short on sleep is negative-EV, s5); load increases blocked; floors compressed into 150min (2x35 strength, 1x35 interval, ~45 Z2). Budget cut and sleep cap point the same direction: floors only.

Week-1 return ramp (s6): volume before intensity - 3-4 easy Z2 + 2 reduced-volume strength (near-prior intensity, no restarted progression); no intervals in week 1; no plyo/high-impact (connective tissue is the rate limiter after >=2 weeks, ramps last). Block marked interrupted: no retest evaluation; a future block needs fresh pre-registration.

interruptions.note: influenza 10 days systemic, then travel tail

scenarios.notes: Same shape as TI1 but longer and more conservative (ramp scales with the 10-day illness, s6), starting one stage earlier: 2-3 days easy aerobic only before strength returns. Plyo blocked on two independent grounds (ramp + active HRV flag). Intervals not before week 2-3.

Week 2 of return: intervals resume this week at reduced dose (one session, 3x3min rather than 4x4) - the week-1 prohibition has expired and volume was rebuilt. Plyometrics not yet: high-velocity channels 22+ days unexposed and connective tissue ramps last; reintroduce next week at minimal dose, fatigue-free conditions only.
